conflicts_and_limits: Dedicated governance office is an enterprise option, not a required solo-project structure.
Source benefits are predictions rather than local performance or recovery evidence.
Central coordination and modular separation do not require merging the function-owned polyrepo estate.
Source automation table contains contradictory accuracy wording; no lower-accuracy objective is adopted.
Linked resources are not certified; rights, adoption, native proof and independent omission certification remain unresolved.
